about: Rounds with no right answer. nhie: 'Never have I ever …' (phones tap I have or Never; the TV shows who). wyr: 'Would you rather …' pairs, and hot: hot takes to agree or disagree with; both score for siding with most of the room. cheeky lists only play when Spicy is on.
